scope: Static review of all 824 database item commands and all 457 remove_cmd entries. No installer was executed.

findings.action: Quarantined entries using scripts/main_installer.sh because that script downloads and extracts Klll-Pro skin regardless of item name.
Disabled four broad wildcard feed-removal commands; Pure2 removal now targets the exact external-extra-feed.conf file.
Recorded remote script-to-shell execution as a risk flag; these commands still require per-script review before production use.
Recorded insecure HTTP command sources; not silently rewritten because HTTPS availability and source identity were not verified.
Recorded TLS verification bypasses; not silently removed without checking endpoint compatibility.
Kept original third-party URLs and attribution metadata. No third-party content was copied without verified redistribution permission.

findings.title: Klll-Pro-FHD restored with item-specific installer
findings.detail: The Klll-Pro-FHD entry now uses scripts/install_klll_pro.sh. The wrapper validates the upstream archive, uses verified HTTPS, does not pre-delete the installed skin, and credits Biko-73. The other 103 shared-installer entries remain quarantined pending individual verification.

findings.title: KeyAdder restored with non-destructive installer
findings.detail: The two KeyAdder category entries now use scripts/install_keyadder_safe.sh. The wrapper validates and stages the fairbird/KeyAdder archive, copies its usr tree without pre-deleting existing plugin folders, and credits RAED/fairbird under GPL-3.0.

findings.title: Levi45 Emulator restored with package-manager installer
findings.detail: The two Levi45 category entries now use scripts/install_levi45_emulator.sh. It downloads the original Emil Nabil IPK/DEB over verified HTTPS, validates the archive header, and installs through opkg/dpkg without manually deleting the old plugin or using force-overwrite.
